businessProblem: Reliance Communications Ltd. faces a critical solvency and operational crisis at end-2017. Very high accumulated debt is not serviceable from operations, the wireless business is under severe pressure from industry-wide price competition, and creditors including Ericsson are actively pursuing enforcement. Asset-sale plans announced to resolve debt have not been executed. The company must determine the highest-priority actions to avoid insolvency.

evidence.finding: Total debt is very high and significantly exceeds cash generation capacity from operations, creating acute solvency risk
Company is dependent on asset monetization to address debt obligations; no major asset sales have been completed
Revenue is declining due to sustained telecom price war reducing average revenue per user across the sector
Wireless operations are under severe pressure from price compression and subscriber churn driven by new low-price entrant
Strategic transition away from the legacy wireless model was announced but has not been executed; the legacy model remains dominant
Telecom industry competition intensified sharply after aggressive low-price market disruption; competitive position materially weakened
Creditor relations are deteriorating; Ericsson and other creditors are actively pursuing outstanding payment claims
Restructuring and asset-sale plan announced by leadership but concrete execution and completed transactions remain absent
Creditor enforcement risk is rising as payment deadlines approach; Ericsson pursuing claims actively

clientContext.size: Large listed telecom operator with national network
clientContext.revenueImpactUrgency: Critical — revenue declining under price war while debt obligations remain fixed; solvency timeline short

ownerConstraintProfile.bottleneckRisk: High — promoter-controlled structure with concentration of decision-making authority
ownerConstraintProfile.followThroughRisk: High — asset-sale and restructuring plans announced but not executed
ownerConstraintProfile.resistanceToChange: Medium — strategic transition was acknowledged but not acted upon with sufficient speed
ownerConstraintProfile.managementCapability: Under severe stress — management is dealing with simultaneous creditor pressure, operational decline, and incomplete strategic execution
